Threshold gating changes the estimand: with G=1{‖s_corrupt−s_clean‖>ε} and Δ=M_patched−M_corrupt, the gated estimate targets E[Δ|G=1], the patch effect among score-responsive corruptions. This is a mathematical implication of selection, not an unconditional population effect; it can favor sensitive examples. Report E[Δ], E[Δ|G=1], gate coverage/counts, score norm, ε, and threshold sensitivity. If nongated examples are never patched, the unconditional effect is unmeasured; assigning them zero instead estimates the gated intervention policy E[GΔ]. Score changes need not change rankings. Patching research confirms that corruption and metric choices materially affect interpretation ([Zhang and Nanda](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.16042)).

For this diagnostic, retain the target once even when previously consumed; exclude observed-history items and the target from unique sampled negatives. Freeze targets and candidate sets across clean, corrupt, and patched conditions. Report repeat-target prevalence and stratified effects, sampling seed/distribution, actual candidate-count distribution, and shortages; fewer candidates make HR@10 easier, and ≤10 guarantees a hit. Prespecify deterministic, target-independent tie-breaking and report tie frequency; rank=1+count(scores>target) is optimistic under ties. Sampled ranking metrics can change model comparisons, so candidate protocols define distinct measurements ([Krichene and Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)).

Bootstrap paired users within each category, preserving every user’s conditions, corruptions, candidates, and gate indicators; recompute gated denominators and the four-category macro-average each resample. Report 95% interval method, resamples, seed, user counts, and undefined empty-gate replicates. Pair-preserving resampling is essential ([SciPy](https://cache-docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html)). With ≤32 training users/category, intervals are exploratory, conditional on selected users/model/candidates—not training or sampling uncertainty. Label diagnostic HR@10 separately from pinned host validation: 200 users/category, 99 unique negatives, seed 42.
